name: Materials Selection in Design
summary: Teaches the systematic Ashby method for choosing the best material and process for a component using property charts, performance indices and cost.

topics.name: Materials in the design process: conceptual, embodiment and detailed design
The families of engineering materials and materials information for design
Material property charts (modulus-density, strength-density, toughness-strength and more)
Translating design requirements: function, constraints, objectives and free variables
Deriving material performance indices (e.g. E^(1/2)/ρ for a light stiff beam)
Screening and ranking with charts and selection lines
Case studies: oars, flywheels, springs, pressure vessels, heat exchangers
Multiple constraints and conflicting objectives; penalty functions and trade-off surfaces
Selection of material and shape: shape factors
Process selection: process attributes, process charts and economic batch size
Cost modelling of materials and processes
Using selection software and databases (Granta EduPack/Selector, MatWeb)
Industrial design, aesthetics and perceived attributes of materials
